meta.name: hellenist_city_invasion
meta.prompt: A modern Hellenist city being invaded by sea monsters.

character.label: modern hellenist coastal metropolis under attack

programs.brief: A gargantuan tentacled sea leviathan breaching the bay waters, with towering serpentine appendages striking harbor walls and glowing bioluminescent eyes.
A fierce predatory multi-limbed sea monster surging up onto the waterfront quays, with jagged scales, dorsal spines, and hooked claws.

tokens.event_direction: giant sea monsters emerging from the harbor waters and attacking the city waterfront
tokens.infra: barricade_line along the coastal avenue and port quays; emergency cordon fencing securing the inner boulevards
tokens.terrain: a grand neoclassical coastal metropolis fronting deep open water with harbors and broad avenues
tokens.icons: colonnaded modern boulevards, monumental marble-faced civic stoas and temples, breached waterfront seawalls, colossal sea beasts rising in the bay

root.label: Neopolis under siege by oceanic leviathans
